University College School

An "enlightened education" that fosters intellectual curiosity, breadth of study, and independence of mind. We nurture and celebrate the individuality of our pupils, encouraging them to shape the direction of their education.

Featuring a cast, crew and band of 50 pupils from all year groups in the Senior School, Our House follows Joe Casey as one life-changing decision sends his future in two different directions. Set in our very own borough of Camden and featuring the iconic music of Madness, this energetic and uplifting musical explores the extraordinary impact of a single choice. Tickets are available via the link in our bio! #UCSHampstead #UCSCommunity #UCSDrama #UCSProduction #UCSMusical
Exciting news! We have been named a finalist for Tatler’s Best Public School! ⭐ What makes this recognition truly special is that it is voted for by the people who know us best - our wonderful parents, Old Gowers, staff, and wider community. This nomination is a testament to the vibrant, supportive, and dedicated community we build together every single day - so a very special thank you to everyone who voted and supported us! #UCS #UCSHampstead #UCSCommunity @tatlermagazine
We were once again featured as one of the top schools in the country by @tatlermagazine in their 2027 Good Schools Guide - which is circulating now with the October edition of the magazine. Thank you Tatler for this lovely write-up. #tatlerschoolsguide
Our Sixth Form Musicians kicked off the year's lunchtime concert series with a fantastic lineup of performances. Last year, our musicians gave an incredible 150 solo performances as part of the series, and if Tuesday's concert is anything to go by, we're looking forward to plenty more brilliant music throughout the year! #UCSHampstead #UCSCommunity #UCSConcert
Yiannis (shell) has qualified for his first European competition, a Tennis Europe Under-12 Category 2 event at Bradfield. He also reached the final of a Grade 3 LTA tournament at Chandos Tennis Club, finishing runner-up. A brilliant run of results against some of the strongest young players in the region. Congratulations Yiannis! #UCSHampstead #UCSCommunity
Last week, our 2nd XV Rugby team welcomed St Michael’s, Argentina, for a valuable sporting and cultural experience. The teams went head-to-head on the pitch before coming together afterwards to exchange gifts and mark the occasion. We hope our visitors had a great time at UCS and enjoyed their time on and off the fields! #UCSHampstead #UCSCommunity #UCSRugby
This summer, our Transitus students took their original show, Propaganda, to the Edinburgh Festival Fringe. Alongside performing their own work, pupils saw up to 20 shows across the week and immersed themselves in the energy of the Fringe, experiencing what it means to be young theatre-makers. A brilliant, ambitious and hugely rewarding week beyond the walls of UCS. #UCSHampstead #UCSCommunity #EdinburghFringe #UCSDrama
Three of our pupils have enjoyed some fantastic achievements on the chessboard in recent months! Can (Sixth) and his Turkish team followed up their Turkish Championship title by finishing as European U18 Team Championship runners-up. Peter (Remove) was crowned U14 Scottish GigaFinal champion after scoring six points from seven games and winning a tie-break, securing direct qualification for the Terafinal at Blenheim Palace. Callum (Lower Remove) competed in the Under 14 section of the UKCC Northern GigaFinal (Semi-Finals) after winning the UKCC MegaFinal (London) in June. He achieved some excellent results against strong junior competitors and shared 4th place. He has now qualified for the UK Chess Challengers, which will take place in October. Congratulations to all on their fantastic achievements! #UCSHampstead #UCSCommunity #UCSPupilAchievements
A big thank you to everyone who attended the recent Old Gowers Sports Day! The weekend was filled with fantastic sporting action, with different teams taking part in hockey, rugby and netball. #UCSHampstead #UCSCommunity #OldGowers #OldGowersSports
From ensembles and bands to performances and lessons, discover how music is part of the everyday experience at UCS in our Music at UCS film. Our Music Scholarship Information Evening for 2027 entry is taking place on Wednesday 16 September from 5 pm. Meet our Music staff and current Music Scholars, tour the Music Department and find out more about the scholarship and audition process. Book via the link in our bio! #UCSHampstead #UCSCommunity #UCSMusic
A new academic year is underway at UCS, and it has been wonderful to welcome our pupils back to school. A particularly warm welcome to all those joining the UCS community for the first time. Here’s to a brilliant 2026/27! #UCSHampstead #UCSCommunity
The new Rugby season is underway at UCS, with teams across the school back on the pitch and ready for another busy term of fixtures. Here’s to a fantastic season ahead! #UCSHampstead #UCSCommunity #UCSRugby

Here’s a look at some of the highlights from this year’s GCSE results, which mark the strongest performance in UCS history. #UCSHampstead #UCSCommunity #GCSEResultsDay2026
Our Year 11 pupils are celebrating an outstanding set of GCSE results today, with 58% of all grades awarded a 9, marking the strongest GCSE performance in UCS history by all measures. Results at a glance: 58% of grades were 9 84% were 9–8 94% were 9–7 19 pupils achieved straight 9s 57 pupils achieved a full set of 9s and 8s There were also exceptional results across individual subjects, with 92% of English Literature grades, 90% of Maths grades, and 80% of History grades being 9, and 80% of Modern Languages grades - French, German, Italian, Mandarin and Spanish - were at 9-8. The vast majority of our pupils will now continue into the Co-ed Sixth Form at UCS, joining around 70 girls from schools across London and beginning the next chapter of their education. Well done to our Upper Remove! #UCSHampstead #UCSCommunity #GCSEResultsDay2026

Headmaster’s welcome
Everyone who visits the UCS Junior Branch comments on the special atmosphere within our school. There is a warmth, vitality and sense of energy that stems from the excellent relations that exist between staff and pupils and between the boys themselves.
We are an academically selective school and we have high expectations of our boys – but, above all, we are a caring community, characterised by good manners and open, honest dealings with everyone.
Our pupils are well supported, both by each other and by their teachers, and as occurs throughout the UCS Foundation, they are encouraged to be themselves. We have extremely high academic standards and yet, at the same time, we emphasise the individual.
The curriculum at the UCS Junior Branch is broad, creative and academically stretching. Our dynamic teachers help our pupils to appreciate the value of learning as a lifelong process which enables them to thrive when they join the UCS Senior School in Year 7.
Our high staff-to-pupil ratio also ensures that our pupils receive the attention they need as they live out these formative Junior School years amid our “special atmosphere”.

Headmistress’ welcome
Throughout the Pre-Prep we aim to provide our pupils with a happy and enriched learning environment as they take their first steps on their educational journeys.
Our well-qualified team of staff support the children in developing their academic, social and emotional skills across a broad range of subjects.
Pre-Prep
Headmistress’ welcome
Blend of learning opportunities
We are an academic school and, naturally, we focus on enabling the children to have very good learning skills. However, we also blend this with a very creative curriculum, meaning there are specialist lessons such as Art, Drama, STEAM and Music in addition to the more traditional Literacy and Mathematics.
The school’s high staff-to-pupil ratio, and Specialist Teachers for Art, Music, PE and French, help to ensure that our pupils receive the focused attention that is so vital and enhancing for their learning.
Intellectual curiosity
We like to give every child the chance to develop at their own pace, while at the same time thoroughly preparing them for their next stage of learning. We offer rich opportunities for our pupils to learn through the creative curriculum with an emphasis on intellectual curiosity.
The fact that the boys are so incredibly engaged in lessons attests to the expertise of our dedicated staff and Specialist Teachers whose creative and immersive teaching is something the children adore.
Happy, supportive and stimulating
The Independent Schools Inspectorate found that the Pre-Prep “successfully achieves its aim to provide a happy, supportive and stimulating environment where intellectual curiosity and independence of mind are developed and self-discovery and self-expression are fostered.”
Indeed, the children positively burst through the school doors every morning and they also enjoy all the facilities across the wider UCS Foundation – including forest school lessons at the Frognal allotment, pond and beehives, not to mention swimming at UCS Active and playing assorted different sports.
A vast array of before and after-school clubs also keeps them busy and buzzing. You might say that we are inspiring the engineers of the future by inviting our pupils to build, create and make as their fancy flies. If the children can dream it, then we can do it!
Zoe Dunn has worked in North London for over 20 years in a variety of independent and state schools.
From an early age, Zoe wanted to teach and after completing her BEd at Homerton College, Cambridge, she followed her passion for books and wrote a PhD in Mid-Victorian Literature.
Ignited by her interest in social and emotional development as well as mindfulness in Early Years, Zoe undertook a Winston Churchill Travelling Fellowship which enabled her to explore different school settings in America and Sweden. She lives in North London with her son, husband and one very fluffy cat.
